title: Wreck and Summit
author: Ulyana Winterbourne
blurb: Oscar Vane, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
